evidence.dwelling_unit: Dwelling Unit in a permitted residential building type

calculation_handling.description: Lists the uses permitted in the R zone: a dwelling unit in a permitted residential building type (per 10.10.20.40), a municipal shelter, and a park. A use permission, not a numeric limit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Municipal Shelter and Park have no vocab.uses token and are not keyed. Building types are not named here (they come from 10.10.20.40), so building_types is 'any'.

10.10.20.10(1).explanation: In the R (Residential) zone, homes are permitted as dwelling units inside one of the residential building types the by-law allows for that zone (listed separately in 10.10.20.40). Municipal shelters and parks are also permitted uses.
